items.title: Michi Fuji interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 3, 2014
items.q: But I like Nigel Kennedy. He’s electric. And he’s very masterful of the classic music.

ctx.x: No that’s a good way to put it. Because if you really get involved in teaching it might take away from your time and your effort and the whole thing. There was a brief time of fusion music in the 70’s, there were some electric violin players, the Mahavishnu Orchestra. Are you familiar with any of that music? Very electric, with the violin going through —
But I like Nigel Kennedy. He’s electric. And he’s very masterful of the classic music. But I like his treatment.

What’s the club scene like in New York now. I know some of them are very expensive to go to, like the Blue Note and so forth. But I imagine there’s other places that are easier for the public to afford. Like Café Loup, where you play, they charge a cover?
